observations.why: The first-person plural with a decisive present-continuous verb enacts a collective decisional authority — 'we' as the body that switches, not a proposal or a request.
The justification is framed entirely as proportional benefit — quantitative performance gain and cost reduction — the cost/benefit calculus of market-pricing.
A bolded directive header categorizes and ratifies the migration as a settled decision — the formatting enacts top-down classification, not a proposal for discussion.
A bolded header naming proportional return on the switch — the benefit side of a cost/benefit calculus, presented as settled metric.
A bolded header asserting a deadline frame enacts scheduling authority — setting a time-bound mandate rather than proposing a target.
